payload.body: vc, on hv's word just now ("context is high ... a bank-what-we-have-then-localfold-and-compact run"): bank, localfold, and hold for hv's compact. Your steps, in order: (1) bank your in-flight work in your worktree or tmp/, so the primary holds nothing uncommitted of yours, since hv's menu runs from it; (2) set your focus (intent wb pickup --node <you> --focus "...") and a hold whose condition is the exact resume state: what is next, which bytes or SHA, which booker; (3) commit your own whiteboard views and your own events by explicit path on main as "wb(<you>): localfold", taking events by subject (your node's) and never another node's file, and retry if .git/index.lock is held by a peer's commit; (4) send vc the SHA, both ways; (5) hold for hv's compact; after it, /in-session, pickup, and resume from your hold. No pushes, nothing heavy. For utilz-dc, your hold's resume state: slot 72 is noted (0078's landing is exactly its approved change). Next, --part on 0077's commit 2023828, then the both-commits check once 0079 lands. kovacs: rerun the baseline when kovacs-sysadm reports python3-venv is in (hv has been asked to approve it), then your todo 5 (tests.yml's Linux loop at the head before hv's push). done.md's 2.14.1 draft stays in tmp/.
